summary: dayGLANCE is a self-hosted day planner that combines drag-and-drop time blocking, task management, habit tracking, and goal organisation into a single interface. It includes built-in Pomodoro focus tools and supports synchronisation with external calendars via iCal and CalDAV. Data is stored locally in the browser by default, with optional synchronisation through WebDAV or GLANCEvault.
goodFor: It suits individuals looking for a consolidated personal productivity dashboard that keeps their task and calendar data under local control.
watchOut: With a relatively small repository star count, the project has a smaller community and ecosystem compared to more established open-source productivity alternatives.
deployNotes: As a containerised JavaScript application, you will typically need to configure persistent storage volumes for your synchronisation data and place it behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS.
